title: Rewrite account_picker_an4_test.dart to exercise AccountPickerScreen's real sort/tap-guard code instead of a hand-copied replica
rule: TQ-8 (regression test must pin the actual fix) / Feathers seam

evidence.quote:
// Test strategy: we test the ordering logic in isolation using the same sort
// algorithm as the fix, and verify the _switching guard behavior via a minimal

why: The file never imports account_picker_screen.dart. AN-4 fixed two real bugs (unstable account ordering; no re-entrancy guard on rapid double-tap causing concurrent account switches — a genuine data-integrity risk for a local-first synced app). This test file instead hand-copies the sort comparator into `_sortedAccountDbFileNames` and hand-copies the `_switching` guard into `_TapGuardWidget`, then tests its own copies. If a future change to the real `_AccountTile._switching` guard or the real sort in AccountPickerScreen.build reintroduces either bug, this suite keeps passing because it never touches the production code — the regression protection is illusory.
recommendation: Test the real AccountPickerScreen (as account_picker_screen_l1_test.dart and account_picker_local_data_missing_test.dart in this same batch correctly do): drive the ordering assertion by seeding accounts via the registry and pumping the real screen (asserting tile order), and drive the tap-guard assertion by tapping the real _AccountTile through the pumped widget tree with a slow-resolving fake switch action.
acceptance_criteria: account_picker_an4_test.dart imports and pumps the real AccountPickerScreen (no private replica of the sort comparator or the _switching guard).
Reverting the AN-4 fix in account_picker_screen.dart (either the sort or the guard) makes this test fail red.
